test_extract_rasp_graph_primitives: test that rasp primitives like tokens, indices, and Full have no edges in the extracted graph
test_extract_rasp_graph_map: test that a rasp.Map program produces a graph with one edge from tokens to the map node
test_extract_rasp_graph_aggregate: test that a rasp.Aggregate with Select produces a graph with four edges and correct sources
test_extract_rasp_graph_class: test the ExtractRaspGraphTest class that validates rasp_to_graph conversion for various RASP programs
test_extract_rasp_graph_output: test the ExtractRaspGraphOutput dataclass with graph, sink, and sources fields from rasp_to_graph
